Location: Barrie, ON

Calian is proud to continue a long-standing contractual relationship with the Department of National Defence (DND) to provide healthcare services to the Canadian Armed Forces. Through the Health Care Provider Contract, Calian employs health care professionals across Canada who are integral to supporting the health and wellbeing of our military members.

Position Overview

Calian Health Services is currently seeking a General Dentist for a part-time position with the CFB Borden dental clinic. The General Dentist will provide comprehensive oral care to members of the Canadian Armed Forces as part of the dental healthcare delivery team.

A refreshing pace from high-volume – this is a environment focused on quality of care, with no overhead or clinic fees.

Responsibilities

  • Provide dental examination, diagnosis, intervention, and management of the full spectrum of dental conditions of the oral-facial complex and anatomical structures.
  • Manage overall / general oral health needs, including but not limited to disease prevention and patient education.
  • Develop care plans with the patient as well as the larger, multi-disciplinary health care team to address patient’s oral health care.
  • Perform therapeutic procedures in fixed and removable prosthodontics, operative dentistry, oral surgery, endodontics, periodontics, preventative dentistry, orthodon

Location2: Victoria, BC

Calian is proud to continue a long-standing contractual relationship with the Department of National Defence (DND) to provide healthcare services to the Canadian Armed Forces. Through the Health Care Provider Contract, Calian employs health care professionals across Canada who are integral to supporting the health and wellbeing of our military members.

Position Overview

Canadian Armed Forces members rely on dedicated civilian Licensed Practical Nurses for their day-to-day health. Calian offers an opportunity to support the men and women of our military without putting on a uniform!

Looking for stability in healthcare?

This role offers guaranteed full-time hours, a reliable salary, and a consistent Monday-to-Friday schedule with daytime hours. No shift rotations, no overnight calls, and no weekends. Just the opportunity to focus on patient care while maintaining a predictable work-life balance.

Responsibilities

  • Perform triage assessments of patients during walk-in hours and patient assessments, which include medical or incident history, physical examinations, vitals signs measurement, and vision acuity testing
  • Perform nursing interventions such as taking vital signs, applying aseptic techniques such as sterile dressing, and ensuring infection control, and conducting specimen collection

Responsibilities

  • Installation of both 48V DC and AC powered rack-mounted equipment.
  • Cable labeling and cable management practices as well as Ethernet cabling.
  • Install frames and rack/mount servers.

Qualifications

  • Familiar with the installation of both 48V DC and AC powered rack-mounted equipment. (This includes all aspects of DC-power cable fabrication, working knowledge of various DC power distribution devices and ability to work with live power.)
  • Familiar with cable labeling and cable management practices.
  • Competent with all aspects of Ethernet cabling.
  • Thoroughly knowledgeable of cable color codes, adept in wire wrap terminations, competent in BIX system and RJ45 and DB cable construction.
  • Familiar with telecom standards
  • General computer knowledge ie: Excel/Word
  • Ability to climb ladders on a daily basis and lift 50+ lbs

Compensation

  • $25-35/hour

“Final compensation will be based on the successful candidate’s skills, experience, qualifications, and contract conditions.”

Vacancy

  • We have 1 (one) available position
